source.citation: Woon, D. E.; Dunning, T. H. Jr. Theory of Hypervalency: Recoupled Pair Bonding in SFn (n=1-6). J. Phys. Chem. A 2009, 113, 7915-7926.

models.M0: parity-only shell bounds; no principal-shell gate
models.M1: v0.5 shell bounds plus explicit principal_n>=3 gate

retrospective_period_gate_sanity.interpretation: The n>=3 gate has retrospective discriminating value, but these labels were already known and cannot support promotion.

next_gate.requirement: Freeze a ligand-family held-out panel before label lookup.
compare: M2 shell-gated plus independent energetic descriptor
next_gate.anti_fit_rule: Do not remove unsupported high-q candidates after labels are revealed.

nonclaims: SF_n does not provide incremental validation of M1 over parity-only M0
the 4-entry period panel is retrospective, not blind
M2 is not implemented or validated
no energetic correction has been added to the molecular Hamiltonian
